title: The Tower of Lapidis IX
wikitext: {{Questbox | name=The Tower of Lapidis IX | start=[[Insom'ni]] | end=[[Hydromancer Flakereef]] | faction=Alliance | id= | level=55 | category=Lapidis Isle | reputation = +25 [[Kul Tiras (faction)|Kul Tiras]] | experience = 450 | rewards = | previous = [[The Tower of Lapidis VIII]] | next = [[The Tower of Lapidis X]] }} == Objectives == Wait for Insom'ni to attune the Enchanted Brass Key, once the key is attuned, return it to Hydromancer Flakereef in Caelan's Rest. * [[Attuned Brass Key]] (provided) == Description == Now, I will do what I can to restore the attunement to this key. It shouldn't be that difficult, the magi who left the magic did a poor job with leaving magical traces upon it. Step back, I will do as you asked, it shouldn't take long. When I am done, you may return to the one who sent you. ==Rewards== * 450 [[XP]] == Progress == How have you fared? Have you gotten any answers about the key? == Completion == Now that the key is attuned, and enchanted, we can begin our planning to destroy Hydromancer Lapidis. ==Notes== Insom'ni will begin channeling magic. After a moment, he will finish. :'''Insom'ni says:''' There, it is done. The key is attuned. Do with it what you must. I hope that it serves you well for whatever purpose you are using it. ==Progression== {{The Tower of Lapidis}}
